controls: Same native robot/camera/aligned TF/radius/padding/inflation/cost scale/speeds/map/start/goal, backend source and initial six-person geometry per scenario. Headless NVIDIA GPU. Humans react to robot, so subsequent human trajectories are outcomes, not fixed replay. MPPI RNG not fixed.
criteria: Each declared cell gets one fresh attempt; no overwrite, retry or tuning during this series.
Capture integrity audit including native uint8 costmaps and numeric static TF must PASS.
Candidate actual goal status SUCCEEDED and independent world XY<=.2m, yaw<=.25rad.
Candidate conservative swept human gap and static-box continuous-segment lower bound must be positive.
Report robot-center entry into triangle of standing-type three-person groups; separately qualify all member speeds<=.05m/s. This is not a validated full social-space label.
Flag minimum human gap reduction>0.10m versus matched baseline for review; do not hide it behind success.
No force-contact stream, no single-parameter causal claim, no multi-seed or social-policy acceptance. Defaults are not promoted in this task.
